queries.label: US index futures
queries.query: (Nasdaq futures OR E-mini Nasdaq OR S&P 500 futures OR E-mini S&P OR Dow futures) AND (CME OR futures OR trading)

queries.label: Gold and silver futures
queries.query: (COMEX gold futures OR COMEX silver futures OR gold futures OR silver futures) AND (CME OR yields OR dollar OR central bank)

queries.label: Currency futures and dollar
queries.query: (Euro FX futures OR British pound futures OR US Dollar Index OR Japanese yen futures OR Australian dollar futures) AND (CME OR ICE OR central bank)

queries.label: WTI crude futures
queries.query: (WTI crude futures OR NYMEX crude oil OR EIA petroleum OR OPEC) AND (inventory OR supply OR demand OR futures)

queries.label: CME Bitcoin futures
queries.query: (CME Bitcoin futures OR CME crypto futures OR regulated bitcoin futures) AND (ETF OR regulation OR market)

queries.label: US macro and central banks
queries.query: (Federal Reserve OR FOMC OR US CPI OR US PPI OR nonfarm payrolls OR PCE inflation OR Treasury auction) AND (futures OR markets OR yields)

queries.label: Futures positioning and open interest
queries.query: (CFTC Commitments of Traders OR COT report OR futures open interest OR CME volume) AND (NQ OR ES OR gold OR crude OR euro OR dollar)
